title: OpenWorker observability recording format 1.3
description: Turns, steps, recording events and exchange pieces, as defined in recording-format.md (version 1.3; 1.0 frozen 2026-10-31, 1.2 added the Phase 2 fields, 1.3 the Phase 3 fields). Field names are those of phase-1/technical-design.md (Draft 5). Validate a recording file against #/$defs/recording, one recording event against #/$defs/event, one line of an exchange piece store against #/$defs/piece, one live message against #/$defs/live_message. Wherever a field may be null, its description says what null means.

short_hash.description: First 6 hex characters of a SHA-256. null = nothing to hash.

step_kind.description: sandbox: added in 1.2 (sandbox setup, Phase 2 OB-13).

recording.description: One recording file: the turns and steps of one or more sessions. Turns are sorted by started_at, then turn_id. Steps are sorted by seq within their turn (the canonical order, recording-format.md section 4); steps of no turn (proxy calls) follow, by started_at.

feedback.description: 1.3. The ratings of the file's turns (OB-5). Absent = none, or the file was written before 1.3.

reviewer_settings.description: Auto-approver settings at turn start (technical design section 4).

model.description: The model used, for kind session_model. null = not a session-model reviewer, or none configured.

stamp.description: Machine, model provider, sandbox and coworker facts taken at turn start (technical design section 9): the groups machine, model and sandbox, and the coworker fingerprint persona_fp. Every key is optional; a missing key means it was not stamped.

id.description: null = the machine has no id (not joined to a controller).

name.description: The machine's name, or the host name. Personal data for Phase 2's export rules (P-7).

provider_title.description: The provider card's name in Settings; identifies which key.

expected.description: 1.2. This machine has a sandbox switched on in Settings, whatever this session used.

persona_fp.description: Coworker fingerprint: first 6 hex characters of the section 9.4 hash. The session record keeps the same value.

persona_id.description: 1.3. The coworker's id (its manifest id), next to persona_fp, so the recording alone says which coworker ran.

persona_coverage.description: 1.3. The scan areas the coworker's manifest promises (its coverage list). Absent = it promises none, and the coverage checks do not run.

team.description: 1.3. A team member's turn: the team and the member's role. Absent = not a team session.

turn.description: One turn: the engine working on one request (technical design section 4).

turn_id.description: A ULID in the app; any unique string in tests.

duration_ms.description: From a monotonic clock. null = unknown: the turn was found open after a crash (status unknown).

ended_at.description: Optional and derived: started_at + duration_ms. null when duration_ms is null. Never read from a clock.

incomplete.description: True if any recording event of this turn was dropped.

approval_mode.description: engine.permissions.mode at turn start, for example auto-approve.

first_message_id.description: mid of the message that opened the turn. null = empty: a retry that appended no message, or a message written before Phase 1.

last_message_id.description: mid of the last message appended before the turn ended. null = no message was appended.

schema_version.description: The record layout version: 1 for every 1.x version of this format. It goes up only when old readers cannot read the new shape.

max_iterations.description: 1.2. The step limit in force for this turn. null or absent = not recorded (before 1.2).

step.description: One unit of work inside a turn (technical design section 5.1). attrs and content depend on kind.

turn_id.description: null = empty: a proxy call, which belongs to no turn.

session_id.description: null = empty: a proxy call, which belongs to no session.

parent_step_id.description: null = not nested. Real nesting only; auto-approver and wait steps link to their tool call by call_id instead (V-09).

seq.description: Position in the turn's canonical order; final when the turn ends.

started_at.description: The turn's started_at plus the monotonic time since the turn started; steps with no turn read the wall clock.

duration_ms.description: From a monotonic clock. null = still running (live only), or status unknown (found open after a crash).

ended_at.description: Optional and derived: started_at + duration_ms; null when duration_ms is null.

call_id.description: The tool_call_id. null = the step is not about a tool call.

call_index.description: The call's position in the model's list of tool calls for that reply. null = not a tool call.

message_id.description: mid of the transcript message this step produced. null = it produced none.

shadow.description: True only for Shadow evaluation checks and their nested model step.

after_turn.description: True when tagged with a turn that had already ended when the step started.

content.description: Text and personal data only (TD-13). {} when there is none.

ended_after_turn_ms.description: Set when a step_ended arrived after its turn had already closed the step: how late it came (section 7.4). Absent otherwise.

usage.description: Token counts of one model call (technical design sections 5.2 and 6.2).

reported.description: Whether the provider gave token counts. When false, the four parts are absent or null and the call adds the at-least marker.

input_fresh.description: Fresh input tokens. null only when reported is false.

cache_read.description: Input reused from cache. null = the provider sent no cache-read count (TypeSafe Jev, older Ollama); left out of the cache share; shown as a dash, never 0.

cache_write.description: Input stored in cache. null = the provider sent no cache-write count (V-05, V-13); shown as a dash, never 0.

output.description: Output tokens, including thinking where billed so. null only when reported is false.

reasoning.description: Thinking tokens within output. null = the provider sent none.

inconsistent.description: Present only when the provider's numbers are impossible; they are kept as sent (V-19).

text.description: The root cause's short text, for example 529. null = none.

provider_facts.description: Fixed names read from provider_meta when the step ends (section 5.2.1). Every fact: null = the provider did not send it.

provider_meta_entry.description: One HTTP response of a model call, as sent, minus content (deny list) and secrets (section 5.2.1).

wire.description: Which API shape. A helper request such as Ollama's /api/show is on the call's own wire, with auxiliary true.

request.description: Every request parameter except content; tools_offered as a count.

events.description: Per event kind, every field of those events merged in order, later values winning, content removed.

auxiliary.description: True for a helper request made before the call (M-R9); never counted as an attempt.

after_call.description: The provider's own record fetched after the call (OpenRouter). null = the fetch failed or is turned off.

blob_ref.description: A reference to one piece in the exchange piece store, by its SHA-256.

exchange_entry.description: One HTTP attempt of a model call: the exact request and the exact response, content included, secrets left out (TD-15, TD-17).

headers.description: Every request header except secrets (section 6 of recording-format.md).

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes sent.

manifest.description: The request JSON with pieces replaced by blob references.

blob.description: For a body that is not a JSON object: the whole body as one piece.

response.description: null = no response arrived (the connection failed).

body_blob.description: The full response body as received (after content decoding), one piece.

piece.description: One line of an exchange piece store file (exchange-store.jsonl), or one row of exchange_pieces.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the piece's bytes (data encoded as UTF-8).

size.description: Length of the piece in bytes.

first_seen.description: When the piece was first stored.

purpose.description: unattributed = a call made with no tags at all (section 3.3).

provider.description: Provider id, the prefix of the model id; openai_decisions or typesafe_jev for decision-model checks.

provider_title.description: null = the provider has no Settings card (decision-model services).

served_by.description: Backend host behind a router. null or absent = not a router, or not said.

provider_meta.description: One entry per HTTP response; the last is the reply.

finish_reason.description: null = the call ended without a reply (failed or stopped).

ttft_ms.description: Time to the first streamed piece of any kind. null = not streamed, or nothing arrived.

context_window.description: From the model catalogue at call time. null = the catalogue has no value.

max_output.description: 1.2. The output limit the request asked for (max_tokens, max_output_tokens). null = none was sent.

decision.description: How a tool call was allowed or refused, stage by stage (section 8.3). A helper's tool step has {helper: true} instead.

detail.description: permission allowed: the reason id (low_risk, bypass, cleared_by_mode); resolved approved_session: which approval (always_tool, always_command, always_domain, always_site, readonly_session). Absent when the outcome has none.

origin.description: The single stage that decided. null = no stage decided (the call never reached a decision: bad arguments, unknown tool, superseded, stopped).

risk_class.description: From risk.classify. null = not classified (unknown tool).

exit_code.description: Shell commands only. null = not a shell command, or it did not exit.

blocked_known.description: When false, blocked sites are shown as unknown, never none.

blocked_count.description: null = unknown: blocked_known is false, or the sandbox gives no counts (V-04, until E13).

args_hash.description: 1.2. Short code of the call's arguments: SHA-256 over canonical JSON, first 6 hex. null = the arguments never parsed.

repeat_ok.description: 1.2. The tool declares that calling it again with the same arguments is normal (polling).

result_error.description: 1.2. The tool ran and returned a result with a non-empty error key instead of raising.

error_kind.description: 1.2. Why a tool step has status error. null = it did not.

reaches_network.description: 1.2. The call reaches the network: risk class egress, or a shell command that names a network client or a URL (review_facts.shell_reaches_network). null = not known (the call never ran).

plan.description: 1.2. todo_write only: the list as written.

helper.description: 1.2. explore only, for display: what its helper did. The pill adds up the helper's own model steps, never this.

team.description: 1.2. Team tools only: ids, no text.

worker_session_ids.description: propose_team only: the sessions it created.

scanner.description: 1.3. run_shell only: the security scanner the command runs, by the fixed word rule of signals.yaml (scanners). null = a shell command that runs no scanner. Absent = not a shell step, or not recorded.

result_sha256.description: 1.3. SHA-256 of the raw result, for evidence (OB-16). null = the call never ran.

decision_details.description: Permission rule text, the allow reason, a standing rule's tool to target.

count.description: null = the sandbox did not report it (V-04: today's sandbox gives host names only, until E13).

first_at.description: Epoch milliseconds. null = not reported (V-04, until E13).

for_call_id.description: null = empty: the summary's Retry-or-trim question.

outcome.description: null or absent = still waiting (live only).

inbox_at.description: 1.2. Epoch ms when the card reached the Inbox: the step's start if it began there, else the step_updated that moved it. null = it never did.

model.description: For session_model. null = a decision-model reviewer.

score.description: Decision-model reviewers only. null = session-model reviewer.

matched_user.description: Shadow checks only. null = cannot be compared (no answer, the check failed, or it said unsure).

reason.description: The reviewer's own sentence. null = none given.

questions.description: A decision model's questions, each with its answer and score. null = not a decision-model check.

session_prompt_hash.description: null = the session has no system prompt.

tokens_before.description: Context tokens of the last main call before. null = no main call reported usage before it.

tokens_after.description: Filled by step_updated when the first main call after it ends. null or absent = not yet.

model_step_id.description: The model call inside it. null = empty: a trim.

notice_name.description: The last four: added in 1.2. controller_offline, nobody_watching and clock_jump have a duration (a gap); the others are zero-length.

notice_attrs.description: {} for every notice except two, which carry what changed, under names already defined elsewhere, with the new value and only the keys that changed. context_changed: the per-turn context block as it is now, under the context step's names (per_turn, size_chars, block_hash). stamp_changed: attended, reviewer or stamp, under the turn's names (stamp holding only the changed groups).

reason.description: 1.2. controller_offline: closed, failed, ping_timeout. sandbox_restarted: folders_changed, runner_restarted.

skipped_ms.description: 1.2. clock_jump: the time the machine slept.

cause.description: 1.2. recording_gap: why the turn was found open.

until.description: 1.2. recording_gap: epoch ms of the app start that found it.

how.description: 1.2. sandbox_restarted: a new sandbox, or folder grants changed in place (Windows).

sandbox_attrs.description: 1.2. A sandbox setup step (kind sandbox, name setup): its stages in the order run.

uncertain.description: download_image only: the provider cannot say how long the pull took.

sandbox_error.description: 1.2. A sandbox failure: the exception's class and its short text.

woken_by.description: 1.2. A team worker's turn: who woke it. null or absent = not a worker turn, or not recorded.

wake.description: 1.3. Why the turn started (OB-17). On every turn. null or absent = not recorded (before 1.3).

reason.description: One reason. When a wake carried several kinds of board row, the first in the order blocker, worker_waiting, review, assigned, prereq_done, board, mention.

kinds.description: Every kind of board row the wake carried. Empty = none.

item_ids.description: The board items involved. Empty = none.

board_seq.description: The board's sequence number (watermark) when the turn started. null = not a team turn.

batched.description: Rows gathered by the review window. null = not batched.

deferred.description: Why and how long the delivery was held back before this turn. null = not held back.

by.description: reason answer only: who answered the card. null = not an answer, or not known.

automation.description: 1.3. A turn an automation run started itself (OB-18). null or absent = not an automation run's own turn (a follow-up typed into the run's session has none).

feedback.description: 1.3. One rating of one turn (OB-5). The note is the person's own text, so it is in content.

auto_approved.description: The step ids of the turn's auto-approved tool steps when it was rated. Empty = none.

changed_at.description: Epoch ms of the last change. null = never changed.

note.description: The person's note. null or absent = none.

live_message.description: One live message on the session's WebSocket while a turn runs (technical design section 12): the recording events of the last 100 ms, unchanged.

event.description: One recording event (technical design section 3.2). Common fields first; the rest depend on type.

mono_ms.description: A monotonic clock in milliseconds, for durations. Only differences within one process mean anything.

error.description: null or absent = no error. Folded into attrs.error.
